template_metadata.description: Template for documenting functional requirements extracted from foundational documents
template_metadata.usage: Copy this template to specs/functional/functional_requirements.json and populate with your system's functional requirements

functional_requirements.description: {What the system must do - describe the capability or behavior}
functional_requirements.category: {authentication | authorization | data_processing | reporting | integration | validation | other}

user_scenarios: {List user scenario IDs that require this capability}
success_criteria: {List success criteria IDs that this requirement satisfies}

functional_requirements.description: System shall authenticate users via username and password
acceptance_criteria: User can log in with valid credentials
User is denied access with invalid credentials
functional_requirements.notes: Must support MFA for admin users

llm_agent_guidance.extraction_method: 1) Read foundational documents, 2) Extract capabilities and behaviors (WHAT the system does), 3) Assign unique FR IDs, 4) Trace to user scenarios and success criteria, 5) Validate 100% coverage
llm_agent_guidance.what_is_functional_requirement: Describes WHAT the system must do (capability/behavior), NOT HOW it does it (implementation) or WHICH component does it (allocation)
good_examples: FR-002: System shall validate input for SQL injection
FR-003: System shall generate monthly reports
